description: Represents a node in the row dimension tree of a pivot table result.

members.name: Children
members.description: Child nodes for multi-level row dimensions.

members.name: DisplayValue
members.description: The display text for this row node.

members.name: Key
members.description: The raw key value for this row node.

members.name: Level
members.description: Zero-based depth level in the row tree.

members.name: RowIndex
members.description: The row index in the rendered table (computed after flattening).

members.name: RowSpan

members.description: Row total values keyed by value field index.
